definitions.ask: Which hue should mark every copy chip and bob-copy card?
definitions.why: In the vault the accent already means links and run chips; blue is free on a task row

choices.label: Dedicated copy hue var(--color-blue), distinct from links, run chips, code, and task rows
Theme accent var(--interactive-accent); copy chips then share a hue with links and run chips

definitions.ask: Should the glossary Copy Chip strand stop calling the inline chip a quiet pill?
definitions.corrects: plugin renders the span as a quiet pill and the fence as a titled card.
